# Navaway

> > Navaway is a European travel guide platform offering curated hotel recommendations, culinary guides, and destination activities across France, Spain, Iceland, Croatia, and beyond.

Navaway specializes in practical travel content for European destinations, with particular focus on French cities like Montpellier, Grenoble, and Paris. The platform partners with GetYourGuide for activities and features UNESCO World Heritage Sites, Mediterranean destinations, ski resorts, and cultural experiences.

## Key Topics

- European travel destinations
- French tourism (Montpellier, Grenoble, Paris, Sète)
- Hotel recommendations and accommodation guides
- Culinary specialties and food tourism
- Mediterranean destinations
- UNESCO World Heritage Sites
- Ski resorts (Tignes, Val d'Isère, La Plagne)
- GetYourGuide activity partnerships
- City center and luxury hotels
- Budget-friendly accommodations
- Food and wine experiences
- Cultural festivals and events
- Walking tours and city exploration
- Mountain celebrations and ski holidays

- [What to do in Lisbon Top 10 activities + Good tips](https://navaway.com/top-10-things-to-do-in-lisbon): Lisbon activities guide: food tours, catamaran cruises & Belem Tower visits

- [Top 5 best hotels in Prague](https://navaway.com/what-are-the-best-hotels-to-stay-in-prague): Hotel recommendations in Prague featuring Mosaic House & AXA Hotel
- [Top 5 hotels to stay in Dublin](https://navaway.com/top-5-hotels-to-stay-in-dublin): Dublin accommodation guide featuring Blooms Hotel near Temple Bar
- [Top 7 things to do in Dubrovnik](https://navaway.com/top-7-things-to-do-in-dubrovnik): Croatia's Dubrovnik attractions including Lovrijenac Fortress & Adriatic sites
- [Top 5 things to do in Ghent](https://navaway.com/top-5-things-to-do-in-ghent): Ghent activities: canal tours, bike tours & medieval Flanders exploration
- [Top 5 things to do in Reykjavik](https://navaway.com/top-5-things-to-do-in-reykjavik): Iceland activities: whale watching, Golden Circle tours & Geysir visits
